headline: Aegis Vopak Q2 profit falls 2.3% to ₹86.6 crore
hook: Profit dips despite double-digit revenue growth
summary: Aegis Vopak Terminals reported a net profit of ₹86.6 crore for the second quarter, marking a 2.3% decline compared to the previous year. Revenue for the period grew by 16.6%, indicating rising operational costs or margin pressure. The company is currently focused on ongoing expansion projects for its storage terminals.
why_it_matters: Margin compression may weigh on short-term stock performance.
